cases.name: Tobey Jo Boyd Myrick
cases.about: He obituary said, "Tobey was born and raised in Palestine, Texas and attended Cayuga I.S.D.  While in school she participated in various sports and formed many friendships.  Tobey was a very dedicated mother to her two biological children and other children as well.  Being a mother was her main priority in life and she took great pride in raising her two biggest blessings. Tobey had an extremely charismatic personality.  When she walked into a room her presence was always known.  She was very opinionated and always let you know where she stood.  She loved being outdoors and taking advantage of everything that nature had to offer.  Tobey was full of energy and had a loving spirit that will live on in the hearts of her children, family, and many friends."
